The '''LD-1 Celebrator''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] manufactured during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. It was used by Wookiees in the celebration of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. During one particular Life Day celebration, it was sold along with the [[Life Day Holo-Tree]], the [[Life Day Orb/Legends|Life Day orb]], [[Life Day robes/Legends|Life Day robes]] and the [[Life Day Tinsel Bomb]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', December 2012 Life Day celebration</ref>
